title: CobblemonHuedMons
description: HuedMons is a side mod that  bring back hue shifting from pokemon stadium 2   for owned pokemons
body:
HuedMons is a side mod that  bring back hue shifting from pokemon stadium 2   for owned pokemons 

How Hue work : 
the mod shift the hue with the original stadium 2 formula adapted with player name and player uuid + pokemon id  and pokemon name  this way every pokemon will be unique
